# JoinOrder Q6e — Canonical JoinOrder 6e

> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 6e; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT
  MIN(k.keyword) AS movie_keyword,
  MIN(n.name) AS actor_name,
  MIN(t.title) AS marvel_movie
FROM cast_info AS ci, keyword AS k, movie_keyword AS mk, name AS n, title AS t
WHERE
  k.keyword = 'marvel-cinematic-universe'
  AND n.name LIKE '%Downey%Robert%'
  AND t.production_year > 2000
  AND k.id = mk.keyword_id
  AND t.id = mk.movie_id
  AND t.id = ci.movie_id
  AND ci.movie_id = mk.movie_id
  AND n.id = ci.person_id
```
